newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norsk Hydro awards Oseberg gas unit deal.
newsitem.headline: Norsk Hydro awards Oseberg gas unit deal.

text.p: Norsk Hydro ASA, as operator of the North Sea Oseberg field, said on Friday it had awarded Saipem UK Ltd a contract for the transportation and installation of the jacket and topsides for the Oseberg D gas platform.
The contract value was around 250 million crowns and the work is due to be completed in April 1999, Norsk Hydro said in a statement.

Oseberg D will have equipment for drying the gas that lands at the Oseberg Field Centre. The D platform will lie 100 metres from Oseberg A at a water depth of 109 metres. Gas processing capacity will be 32 million cubic metres per day.

Licence holders in Oseberg unit are Norsk Hydro with 13.68 percent, Den norske stats oljeselskap AS with 64.78 percent, Saga Petroleum with 8.55 percent, Elf Petroleum with 5.77 percent, Mobil with 4.33 percent and Total with 2.88 percent.
